text: The Patriots' offensive woes deepened this week as Greg Van Roten was placed on injured reserve with a thigh injury, further compromising the protection around quarterback Drake Maye at a moment when the unit can least afford it—New England sits dead last in the NFL with just 9.7 offensive points per game following a 35-6 demolition at the hands of Jacksonville, a loss in which Maye coughed up three turnovers (two interceptions and a fumble) that sparked considerable analysis about whether the team is deploying the young QB correctly. Maye himself addressed the carnage head-on, calling both his own play and the offense's performance "unacceptable" as he begins searching for answers in what's become an urgent situation. The Patriots now prepare to travel to Buffalo for a Sunday 1 PM ET showdown against the Bills at Highmark Stadium, hoping for a reset in Week 4.
